content: निरस् €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To cast out, throw or drive away, give up, quit, drive or send back; निरस्तगाम्भीर्यमपास्तपुष्पकम् <ls>Śi. 1. 55</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">9. 63</ls>. .²2 To destroy, ward off, defeat, annihilate, dispel; अह्नाय तावदरुणेन तमो निरस्तम् <ls>R. 5. 70</ls>; रक्षांसि वेदीं परितो निरास्थत् <ls>Bk. 1. 12</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">2. 36</ls>. .²3 To turn out, remove, expel, banish; गृहान्निरस्ता न तेन वैदेहसुता मनस्तः <ls>R. 14. 84</ls>. .²4 To throw out, discharge (as arrows). .²5 To reject, repudiate, decline. .²6 To refute, confute, controvert (as arguments). .²7 To eclipse, obscure, throw into the back-ground; यशांसि सर्वेषुभृतां निरास्थत् <ls>Bk. 1. 3</ls>. .²8 To tear out, strip off. .²9 To stretch out (as a hand).
